safeguards.title: Approve the roster before the held cases are decided
safeguards.predict: In scene 3 someone tries to approve before review. Without the block, what is approved - and what happens when the reviewer decides afterwards?
safeguards.look_for: Scene 3 approves the roster with three cases undecided. When the reviewer decides in scene 4, the correct roster differs from what was approved, so the approval in scene 5 is refused and fixing it needs a second, superseding release with a reason. One clean approval becomes two.
safeguards.protects: Nothing is approved while a possible id change, a missing id or a possible duplicate is waiting for a reviewer.
safeguards.defend: Approving with open questions means the access list is wrong for whoever is in them, and fixing it later needs a second, superseding release. Blocking until review is done keeps one clean approval.
